**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/30 (Tue) 13:08
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Apache Kafka is a distributed streaming platform that can be used to process real-time data streams.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] In the context of a real estate portal, Kafka can be used to stream real-time data related to property listings, purchases, sales, and rentals.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Data can be processed in real-time using Kafka Streams or KSQL to extract meaningful insights and trigger real-time actions based on specific events.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Example steps to use Kafka for streaming property listing data include setting up a Kafka cluster, creating a topic for property listings, producing data to the topic, and processing the data in real-time.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Sample Java code provided for producing property listing data to Kafka:
  ```java
  Properties producerProperties = new Properties();
  producerProperties.put("bootstrap.servers", "localhost:9092");
  producerProperties.put("key.serializer", "org.apache.kafka.common.serialization.StringSerializer");
  producerProperties.put("value.serializer", "org.apache.kafka.common.serialization.StringSerializer");

  Producer<String, String> producer = new KafkaProducer<>(producerProperties);
  String propertyListingData = "{\"id\": 1, \"price\": 100000, \"location\": \"New York\"}";
  ProducerRecord<String, String> record = new ProducerRecord<>("property-listings", propertyListingData);
  producer.send(record);
  producer.close();
  ```
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Sample JavaScript code provided for consuming property listing data from Kafka:
  ```javascript
  Properties consumerProperties = new Properties();
  consumerProperties.put("bootstrap.servers", "localhost:9092");
  consumerProperties.put("key.deserializer", "org.apache.kafka.common.serialization.StringDeserializer");
  consumerProperties.put("value.deserializer", "org.apache.kafka.common.serialization.StringDeserializer");
  consumerProperties.put("group.id", "property-listings-consumer");

  KafkaConsumer<String, String> consumer = new KafkaConsumer<>(consumerProperties);
  consumer.subscribe(Collections.singletonList("property-listings"));
  while (true) {
      ConsumerRecords<String, String> records = consumer.poll(Duration.ofMillis(100));
      for (ConsumerRecord<String, String> record : records) {
          System.out.println("Received property listing: " + record.value());
      }
  }
  ```
- [USER] Asked how Kafka streams real-time data on properties and real estate.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Kafka acts as a messaging system allowing different components of the real estate system to communicate in real time.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] When a property is listed, that information can be streamed to the Kafka cluster for processing and analysis.
